verdict.rationale: Algolia documents a public REST Search API to search, configure, and manage indices and records. The docs cover header-based authentication and retry and high-availability guidance, and official clients exist in nine languages under an SLA. Community users report driving it programmatically, such as importing data with a node script and syncing through a cloud function. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths (all returned 404), and the pack has little endpoint-level detail beyond the Search API overview.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Algolia Search API lets you search, configure, and manage your indices and records
Add these headers to authenticate requests:
Official clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin, .NET
The official API clients are covered by Algolia’s Service Level Agreement
To guarantee high availability, implement a retry strategy for all API requests using the URLs of your servers as fallbacks
